explanation: Batch 4 (waves 56-61), measured function by function (m:batch4-seed39-causes; m:batch4-pair-and-slide-fix). The pair's one band-3 cause (seed 4 at 10 households, web 1.2 -> 16 s) was wave 61's privy slide crossing a door's way, fixed in the batch (slide toward the seat's own end). The audit's 'no way around it' was answered with two index fixes: the track-out sweep boxes the steadings once (fabric_hits_boxed: 13,488 -> 3,969 fabric tests, 0.47 -> 0.33 s profiled on seed 39) and the plots' sun boxes are memoized (_sun_keepouts 0.71 -> 0.42 s); both leave the five maps byte-identical. The pair after them: reference TOTAL -6.2%; 10 households 0.0%, 20 -0.8%, 40 -0.9%. The two crossings left are seed 4: +10.7% at 10 households (web: settle_reach 0.52 s and settle_field 0.35 s settling more reaches) and +11.5% at 20 (homesteads: _way_for 0.89 -> 1.59 s, 57 _first_admitted calls 1.27 s laying the households' ways in the gaps between re-placed parts; hinterland: village_grove 0.39 -> 1.28 s drawing 298 grove pieces) - the searches running over ground the batch's rules re-placed (waves 56, 59, 61), and on seed 39 the village grove seating 313 clumps where wave 61's seating took 7, i.e. the trees planted. Seed 25 at 40 households, refused in the base, draws (T140).
